description: This file contains implementation of pointwise tensor operations (addcdiv and addcmul) optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including caching mechanisms and graph execution logic.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS graph tensors used in pointwise operations to optimize repeated computations.

methods.name: addc_mul_div_out_mps
methods.description: Performs element-wise multiplication or division of tensors with optional scalar, utilizing MPS graph caching and execution.
